uncovered_shapes.sentence: Researchers found that current models can imitate human writing and speech patterns so closely that detection tools powered by AI itself often fail to flag them correctly, showing how quickly the technology is improving at blending into normal online interactions.

claims.claim: Eligible US college and grad students can claim four free monthly billing periods of ChatGPT Plus by October 31, 2026.
claims.episode_span: If you’re a full-time or part-time student at an eligible US college or graduate school, you can still grab four free months of ChatGPT Plus before the offer ends tonight.
claims.source_title: Last day: 4 free months of ChatGPT Plus for US students (claim by Oct 31)
claims.supporting_quote: If you've been sitting on this, today is the claim deadline. OpenAI's help article still says eligible US college and grad students get four free monthly billing periods of Plus.

claims.claim: A new AI agent called Zest acts like a group chat helper that asks everyone what kind of food they want, suggests places, lets the group vote, and then makes the reservation over text.
claims.episode_span: A new AI agent called Zest acts like a group chat helper that asks everyone what kind of food they want, suggests places, lets the group vote, and then makes the reservation over text.
claims.supporting_quote: Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.
